finalText:
Big but mostly mechanical: **94 files, about 1,290 hits.** Roughly 1,080 are safe.

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` | 61 | Applied in prod. Edits break the down step. |
| SQL strings in `*/repo/*.js` | 125 | Real DB column. Needs its own migration. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | Generated. `vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| [openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16), `WIRE` value in [serialize.js](lib/serialize.js:8) | 6 | Frozen public contract. |

The `payload` JSON key is a fifth trap. New rows would disagree with old.

Next: require the diff to skip those zones.
